text: When we stop taking turns and one partner has become the default caregiver, and that’s taken for granted, it’s time to bring in other support, or the romance could collapse under the burden. Then ask each other out loud whether the romance actually needs less intensity, should become a friendship, or should end. I can’t answer that for others (and couldn’t always answer it for myself), but asking it is usually the first step.
section: Different levels in different domains can be complementary
reader: someone reading an essay on romance for advice they can use in their own dating and relationships
